content: Iwe ngo ye fel depel Saul irel molwe resa limeseloh yeramtawe. Saul Ye Hafohoyur Chotugul Kowe Ralale chog ngo yesa chaep yar hafohoyur chotugul kowe woal Jerusalem. Panger chotugul kowe ngo resa medardar fedal, re sala meldiy chog apostel kowe. Chotugul kowe resa roloh woal mokwe faluyel Samaria mo Judea.
Sibis chotugul kowe re sala leba Stephen le re tetangdi le ye palleng yalol yar tang.
Iwe ngo Saul yesa luluwaley le yebe hamolaholoh Eklesia we. Yesa loh irel sew mo sew imw sala yururwey Kristiano mo iyang le mal mo fefel, iwe yesa ppedirlong lal kalbus.
Re Foloyu Ebangelium We Mo Woal Samaria
Chotugul kowe resa medardar fedal resa roloh wol pangal lobos re sala foloyu Ebangelium we.
Philip yesa loh woal haplom we ye paleng mo wol Samaria sala foloyu kofal Kristus ngalir rechokwe re mel iyang.
Yarmat re talenga hamayu mokwe Philip ye foloyu. Re talenga ngo re wiri kkemal kowe ye foru.
Yesa chuchuy moniyan mo uwor yarmat le rema ttawul loh ngo resa chuy. Ngo ye cholop rechoka re mahatgut mo rechoka ye mes pecher le ye chuyloh yar tomay.
Sa kkel yar yarmat rraey wol haplom we.
Ye mel semal mal le Simon idal le ye mel wol haplom we le yarmetal Samaria kowe rema lluwdah irel faolus kala yal. Ye kangalur yarmat le iy semal yarmat le ye tagiyet.
Iwe ngo panger yarmat wol haplom we le, chototol mo chotagiyet ngo re talenga yalol. Re sor bo, “Iye kkemal we yael Deus we rema sor bo, ‘Kkemal we ye Hartal Tagiyet.’”
Re talenga yalol bo yagil mala sa ssulay yar ma lluwdah ngo re fodloh irel faolus kowe yal.
Ngo yela yodwe resa chepar ngal foloy kowe yael Philip, le ila Hapatpat Momay we kofal mala Lamliyel Deus mo kofal Jesus Kristus, ngo resa rol baptismus, le fengal mal mo fefel.
Simon mwo ngo ye wol chepar. Yodwe yesa baptismus ngo yesa dabey fedaley chog Philip. Ngo ye lluwdah irel hagil mo kkemal kowe ye wiri we Philip ye foru.
Apostel kowe woal Jerusalem resa rongrong le yarmetal Samaria resa talenga molwe yalol Deus; iwe resa fangloh Pedrus mo John irer.
Rela budoh wol Samaria resa mapelar chotugul kowe bo hare yebe yoh ngalir Espritu Santus.
Bo yodla ngo ye ted bidiy Espritu Santus uwor; re rol baptismus chog irel idel Samol Jesus.
Pedrus mo John resa yetedah payur uwor, iwe ngo yesa bidiy Espritu Santus uwor.
Simon ye wiri yal bidiy Espritu Santus uwor chotugul kowe irel yodwe apostel kowe re yetedah payur uwor. Iwe yesa fang salpiy ngal Pedrus mo John,
ngo yesa sor bo, “Ha fang ngalyey kkemal la, bo hare te tugul semal le ibe yetedah payi uwol ngo yebe bidiy Espritu Santus uwol.”
Pedrus yesa kangalu bo, “Ha chuy fengal mo salpiy la lom hasa loh Infiyerno, bo hosa luluwaley le hobe chuwayi kkefang la yael Deus ngal salpiy!
Tor doh igegam hare kofam irel yengang ka yamem, bo lal mala depom ila ye tafel mo fael metal Deus.
Ligdi luluwal la yam le ye tayikof. Iwe ngo hosa mepel ngal Samol bo be ffaho depal ngalug irel mala hola luluwaley tappel mele iye sengal.
Bo isa wiri le ye kkel yam loltomay ngo ho tay tal mo luwul molfid.”
Simon sa kangalu Pedrus mo John bo, “Fael pechemi ngo habe mapel ngal Samol bo yagilyey, bo hare tor sew meka hasa sor le be wel ngalyey.”

Wol miril yar hatosiya mo yar foloyu ngalir yarmat molwe yalol Samol, ngo Pedrus mo John resa tefael loh woal Jerusalem. Iwe ngo irel yar loloh ngo re fofoloyuloh Hapatpat Momay le wol sew mo sew mokwe haplomol Samaria.
Philip Mo Mall Ethiopia We Ye Tagiyet
Semal angelus kowe lol Samol sa kangalu Philip bo, “Hafleh hobe loh Iyor irel yalap la ye bidiy mo Jerusalem sa loh Gaza.” (Yalap le ila re tay teptap igla ka.)

Iwe Philip yesa hafle sa loh. Iwe ye mel semal mall Ethiopia le semal eunuch. Iy semal mal le ye tagiyet bo iy mele ye holu salpiy la lol mala Queenel Ethiopia. Yodle ngo mal le yesa tetefael ngal bugtal. Ye loh wol Jerusalem bela hasrowu Deus, ngo igla yesa tetefael loh lobugtal le ye dage kuruma la wal. Yodle ye meraraloh, ngo ye yewaw mo irel babior we yael profeta Isaiah.
Espritu Santus yesa kangalu Philip bo, “Ho loh ho bela harepa kuruma lay.”
Sa loh Philip sala rongrong yal yeramtawe yeyawli babior we yael profeta Isaiah. Iwe ngo sa kasiya bo, “Ho medaf irel mekla ho yeyawli?”
Tamol we yesa hatfaeli le ye sor bo, “Be ifa sengal ngo isa medaf le be tor le be hamdefa ngalyey?” Iwe sa kangalu Philip bo yebe chudah yuchul kuruma we. Iwe Philip yesa chudah sala marro lengchel.

Iye pedal lobowe yeramtawe ye yeyawli mo yuchul kuruma we: “Ye wochog semal saaf le resa hasiloh bo re bela lliy. Ye wochog semal fadiyel saaf le te maliliy irel yodwe re guru loh mokwe yulal. Sepad mwo hapatpat ngo yete sor.
Resa tapeli kamemal ngo tor mmalel le re fang ngali. Tor semal le be mmal le yebe sor kofal daola yal, bo sa yug molow la yal mo wol talop le.”
Tamol we yesa kasiya Philip bo, “Kangaluyey hare itey mele profeta le ye kekapta kofal? Kofal iy lufulyal hare kofal semal mo solbos?”
Philip yesa chapiy yael hapatpat mo irel mokwe yeramtawe yesa yawli we ye mel lal babior we ye santus. Iwe ngo yesa kangaliy Hapatpat Momay we kofal Jesus.
Yodwe re dedabeloh yalap we ngo re sala budoh solbos le yor chael iyang, iwe ngo tamol we sa kangalu Philip bo, “Sew chael iye. Ila ngo meda mele be piltayey mo irel yai be baptismus?”
Iwe tamol we sa sor bo be ppoloh kuruma we, ngo iy mo Philip resa dediy lal chael we ngo Philip sa baptismusgili mo iyang.
Yodwe re bidah mo lal chael we ngo Espritu Santus yesa hasiloh Philip. Tamol we tay wiriloh, iwe sa taboloh yal loh le sa rraey lal depal.
Philip yela gola chog ngo yesa mel wol Azotus; iwe yesa loh wol Caesarea, iwe ngo irel yal loloh ngo ye fofoloyuloh Hapatpat Momay we wol sew mo sew haplom.

footnotes.text: -37 v 37 Philip sa kangalu bo, “Be yoh le hobe baptismus igle gel ho chepar le be ilawey mo lal depom.” Mal we yesa hatefali ngo yesa sor bo, “Iy chepar. Ye tugul lal depey le Jesus Kristus ila iy Lol Deus.”
